summaryText:
Hi,

Here is the end-of-day summary for 9 September 2026.
Total work logged: 10h 55m.

Tickets worked on today:

AEME-6282 — 
  Customers exploited multi-tab checkout to redeem and cancel rewards points on 22 UAE orders. 18 remediated via PC-48490. 4 remain with insufficient GCRM balance — partial redemption script prepared under PC-53503. (45m)

AEME-6499 — 
  Five stuck AE orders investigated; 4 progressed to COMPLETED. One order remains in SHIPPING_REQUESTED after partial cancellation. Parallel Kibana, codebase, and DB analysis launched to identify root cause and remediation path. (35m)

AEME-6540 — 
  Two completed AE orders have clawback processes stuck in RUNNING after Checkout.com declined the clawback authorization. Card declined for both orders. Remediation script not yet created — awaiting confirmation to proceed. (2h 0m)

GMT-19192 — 

GMT-20796 — 
  Investigation was in progress with only a lock file present and no RCA written. Parallel Kibana and DB analysis were being launched to identify root cause. RCA completion and next steps remain pending. (45m)

PC-53768 — Script to copy paymentInfo to clawback PaymentTransaction and retrigger ClawbackProcess
  No RCA file existed for this ticket — investigation had not yet been completed. Ticket content was not yet analyzed. RCA investigation and root cause analysis remain pending as the immediate next step. (1h 0m)

RT-702249 — 
  Investigation was in progress with only a lock file present and no RCA written yet. Parallel investigation fan-out covering Kibana, DB, and codebase was being prepared. RCA completion and remediation next steps remain pending. (35m)

SAHME-3357 — 
  14 ZA orders with SMC errors investigated. 11 remediated after SMC team completed device and product mappings. 3 remain stuck — unmapped device model, invalid identity document, and unmapped product ID. Awaiting SMC team confirmation. (1h 0m)

SAHME-3407 — 
  No RCA file was found for this ticket — only residual EOD generation logs existed. Investigation had not been completed. RCA investigation and root cause analysis are needed as the immediate next step. (1h 15m)

SAHME-3409 — 

SAHME-3421 — 
  Investigation was in progress with only a lock file present and no RCA written yet. Parallel investigation covering Kibana, DB state, and codebase trace was being prepared. RCA completion and remediation next steps remain pending. (45m)

SAME-3958 — 
  SA daily sales report missing affiliate_name and multistore_verificationcode columns. Groovy script needs two new ColumnMethod handlers added to getColumns set. Code modification requires build and deployment of sapreporting extension. (2h 15m)

SAME-3962 — 
  Investigation in progress — 18 SA-region orders with refund failures. Ticket fetched and parallel fan-out launched covering Kibana logs, DB state, codebase trace, and PC ticket search. RCA pending completion of investigation.

Open tickets:

PC-53768 [To do] — Script to copy paymentInfo to clawback PaymentTransaction and retrigger ClawbackProcess
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53503 [To do] — Redeem rewards points (partial) for 4 AE orders - AEME-6282
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53529 [To do] — [SAM-24720] Create DB cleanup cronjobs for SMI cluster
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

SAM-24720 [Code Review] —  Update or create Cronjob for autocleanup
  Todo: Hi ~@email,
   Please find below details : 
SAP incident : https://me.sap.com/cases/002075129500011086542026/overview
Sa

Thanks,
Aryan
